name: hq-duotone-line
label: 黄雀 Duotone 线性 / HQ Duotone Line
medium: vector SVG (hand-authored in this design system — NOT image-generated; keep vector for crispness)
preamble: Minimal duotone line icons on a dark backdrop: uniform stroke, rounded caps and joins, drawn in near-white, with exactly one semantic part accented in warm gold plus a small graded halftone dot cluster as the set motif. Refined, geometric, operational.
background_context: #070b13 dark app background; default mounted on a rounded tile rgba(231,178,76,.08) with border rgba(231,178,76,.18), radius 14

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area ~80% (glyphs span ~2.6..21.4); optical sizing so circles read equal to squares
construction.stroke: uniform 1.7 units, rounded caps and joins (matches the product's UI stroke icons in cloud-shell.js)
construction.angles: geometry on 45° increments; diagonals only for pens/planes/trends
construction.detail_budget: one core idea, <=3-4 elements, generous negative space
construction.fill_rule: outline only; gold fill allowed ONLY on the single accent part (dot, spark, play triangle) or a 14-16% gold wash inside one accent shape
construction.color_rule: duotone: near-white #eaf1fa defining stroke + warm gold #e7b24c on exactly ONE semantic key part; accent stays smaller than the white linework
construction.shared_parts: one canonical person (circle head r~3.6-3.8 + shoulder arc), one canonical magnifier, one canonical coin (circle + offset arc), one canonical 4-point spark
construction.motif: graded halftone dot cluster — 5 gold dots r0.85 at opacities .85/.6/.55/.4/.35, tucked in one empty corner of every icon (translation of oil-slides screentone into 黄雀金)

fits: Capability/marketing spot icons, empty states, feature grids, slide decks. NOT for 16-24px dense nav — use the mono line set in ui_kits/workbench/hq-icons.js there.
notes: Existing set: assets/icons-duotone/hq_*.svg (16 icons). When adding icons, copy an existing file as skeleton, reuse shared_parts, keep exactly one gold accent + one dot cluster.
